title: today's search hides or keeps trains by comparing clock times, not moments

evidence.where: src/renfe/search.py, the default 'from now' filter: after = minute.time(), then leaves(t).time() >= after
evidence.why_wrong: it compares the time of day in Madrid with each departure's local clock time; a departure labelled in another time zone, or one on the night the clocks go back, is hidden or kept by the wrong hour
evidence.keep: an explicit --after keeps its documented local-time meaning
